items.originalTitle: FIA partners with AWS to help drive future F1 regulations
detailZh: 国际汽联与亚马逊云服务合作，助力未来一级方程式规则制定
赛车运动的监管机构将利用亚马逊云服务的云和人工智能工具，提升其制定技术规则的能力
国际汽联宣布与亚马逊云服务达成一项广泛的合作，旨在提升其数字能力
亚马逊云服务将作为官方人工智能和云计算合作伙伴加入，监管机构将使用亚马逊云服务的AI工具套件，以提高其制定未来技术规则的能力
国际汽联也在AWS的高性能计算技术上运行其空气动力学模拟，这使得它能够在虚拟世界中进行空气流动测试，而无需构建物理部件，从而加快了进程并降低了相关成本。
AWS的集成是国际汽联更广泛的数字化转型的一部分，正如主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆所解释的。他说，‘技术正在改变我们体育的每一个部分，国际汽联必须引领这一变革。我们与AWS的新合作将支持从未来汽车到许多职业生涯开始的地方的草根俱乐部的一切。’
“通过将世界级的云和AI技术引入国际汽联的核心，我们可以使车手、官员和志愿者更容易参与其中，帮助我们的会员俱乐部更有效地工作，并更接近我们翻倍全球赛车运动参与度的目标。”
AWS已经是F1管理的现有合作伙伴，自2018年加入以来一直是其创新技术合作伙伴。在众多服务中，AWS工具处理用于广播的遥测数据，为实时策略预测提供动力。
detailEn: FIA partners with AWS to help drive future F1 regulations
Motorsport's governing body will use AWS's cloud and AI tools to improve its ability to shape technical regulations
The FIA has announced a wide-ranging partnership with Amazon Web Services as it aims to upgrade its digital capabilities.
AWS will join as its Official AI and Cloud Computing Partner, as the governing body will use AWS's suite of AI tools to improve its capability to produce future technical regulations.

The FIA also runs its aerodynamic simulations on AWS’s High Performance Computing technology, allowing it to conduct air flow tests in the virtual world without having to build physical parts, speeding up the process and reducing the costs involved.

The AWS integration forms part of the FIA’s wider digital transformation, as president Mohammed Ben Sulayem explained. "Technology is changing every part of our sport, and the FIA must lead that change. Our new partnership with AWS will support everything from the cars of the future to the grassroots clubs where so many careers begin.

"By bringing world-class cloud and AI technology into the heart of the FIA, we can make it simpler for drivers, officials and volunteers to take part, help our Member Clubs work more efficiently, and move closer to our ambition of doubling global motor sport participation."

AWS is already an existing partner of F1 management, having joined in 2018 as its innovation technology partner. Among other services, AWS tools process telemetry data for broadcast use, powering live strategy predictions.

items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has said that "a lot of teams" have shown interest in the performance of the Red Bull-Ford Powertrains power unit.
detailZh: 洛朗·梅基斯透露，在阿斯顿·马丁传闻的背景下，多支F1车队对红牛-福特动力单元表现出“关注”
红牛-福特动力单元在2026年非常有竞争力，那么他们未来是否会为更多车队提供动力单元，包括阿斯顿·马丁？从本周五起，在天空体育F1直播观看墨西哥城大奖赛的全部各节练习与排位
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯谈到了他们是否可能向其他一级方程式车队供应其动力单元
红牛老板洛朗·梅基斯承认，已有多支车队关注其车队动力单元的性能。
今年早些时候，国际汽联认定红牛拥有最强的引擎，这一决定颇具争议，因为梅赛德斯获准进行升级，原因是他们在内燃机性能上落后红牛超过百分之二。
今年是红牛与福特合作打造自家动力单元的第一个赛季，很少有人预料到它在2026年就具备竞争力。

这与阿斯顿·马丁本田动力单元缺乏性能形成鲜明对比，该动力单元让费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔大多只能在车阵后方竞争。
有传闻称阿斯顿·马丁正在评估与本田的未来合作，甚至有可能采用红牛-福特的动力单元。
“我们的引擎性能引来了大量不想要的正面关注，这当然也引起了众多车队的注意，”梅基斯说道。
“我们有没有认真和任何人谈过为另一支车队提供动力单元？没有，我们认为我们还没准备好。这件事在未来五年内是板上钉钉的吗？不是，因为我不知道未来五年会发生什么。”
“我们还有很多工作要做，以改进动力单元、完善其与赛车的整合，并达到顶尖竞争对手的水平。只有到那时，我们才能考虑在小红牛（小红牛）之外为另一支车队提供动力单元。未来一年左右不会有任何变化。”
2026年美国大奖赛精彩集锦
梅基斯表示，红牛-福特动力单元项目在2021年从“零”起步，并在他们的首个F1赛季打造出有竞争力的动力单元，完成了“非凡的工作”。
他告诉天空体育F1：“人们意识到这是一台非常好的引擎。不过我们保持脚踏实地。我们认为最好还是专注于红牛和小红牛。”
“目前，你可能会看到赛车在赛道上平稳运行，但现实是，米尔顿凯恩斯的每个人都在日夜奋战，非常努力地让车队保持在合理状态以维持运转。”
“这仍然是充满所有这些挑战的第一年，所以在不久的将来，我们将专注于这两支车队。”
纽维：本田的新项目大有希望
阿斯顿·马丁本赛季仅获得七个积分，在车队积分榜上排名第十，尽管费尔南多·阿隆索表示，如果不是在奥斯汀周日与威廉姆斯的亚历克斯·阿尔本发生接触，车队本有望迎来迄今为止最好的一场比赛。
车队领队阿德里安·纽维表示，本田的差距“相当明显”，但他对这家日本引擎制造商的新研发进展感到鼓舞。
“本田——现在有很多能量和项目正在推进，这些或许还处于开发的早期阶段，但我们从中看到了很多希望，”他说。
“现在要评论动力单元在赛季初的确切位置还为时过早，也无法判断届时——假设动力单元咨询委员会（PUAC）允许——在第一阶段结束时的第八场比赛前是否会有进一步的研发。”
阿德里安·纽维回应了克里斯蒂安·霍纳在其最新回忆录中提出的批评。
本田的挣扎让人想起2015至2017年他们与迈凯伦的涡轮混合动力合作时期——那段时间他们从未拥有过有竞争力的引擎。
迈凯伦和本田在2017年底分道扬镳，本田从2018年起为当时叫红牛二队、如今叫小红牛的车队供应引擎，并从2019年起为红牛供应引擎。
在本田与红牛合作的第一个赛季，他们就在赛季揭幕战登上领奖台，马克斯·维斯塔潘赢下了三场比赛。
纽维表示：“目前，说实话，本田在某种程度上落后于红牛——作为厂队，红牛在2019年接手了本田。但那显然是在他们2015年首次回归后的四个赛季之后。所以，这只是回归的第一年。”
“他们是一家伟大的公司。我完全相信他们会迅速加速，并理解这些特定动力单元规则的问题。”

detailEn: Laurent Mekies reveals 'attention from F1 teams' in Red Bull-Ford Powertrains power unit amid Aston Martin rumours

The Red Bull-Ford Powertrains power unit has been very competitive in 2026, so could they supply more teams in the future, including Aston Martin? Watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports F1
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies discusses whether they could supply other Formula 1 teams with their power unit
Red Bull boss Laurent Mekies has admitted there has been attention from "a lot of teams" about his outfit's power unit performance.

Earlier this year, the FIA deemed Red Bull to have the strongest engine, a contentious decision given Mercedes were granted an upgrade as they were more than two per cent behind Red Bull's internal combustion engine performance.
This year is the first season Red Bull, in collaboration with Ford, have built their own power unit which very few people expected to be competitive in 2026.

It is a contrast to the lack of performance in Aston Martin's Honda power unit which has left Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll mostly fighting towards the rear of the grid.
There have been rumours that Aston Martin were looking into their future with Honda and even the possibility of taking a Red Bull-Ford power unit.
"We got a lot of unwanted positive publicity about the performance of our engine, and that came with certainly attentions from a lot of teams," said Mekies.

"Are we having any serious conversations with anyone to supply another team? No, we don't think we are ready for that. Is it set in stone for the next five years? No, because I don't know what's going to happen in the next five years.

"We still have plenty of work to do to improve the power unit, refine its integration into the car and reach the level of the top competitors. Only then can we consider supplying another team alongside Racing Bulls. Nothing will change over the next year or so."
Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Mekies says the Red Bull-Ford Powertrains programme have done a "phenomenal job" after launching from "zero" in 2021 to build a competitive power unit in their first F1 season.
"People realise it's a very good engine. However, we have our feet on the ground. We think it's better to concentrate on Red Bull and Racing Bulls," he told Sky Sports F1.

"We are, at the moment, you may see the cars on track running smoothly but the reality is it's days and nights, very hard work for everyone back at Milton Keynes to keep the teams in a reasonable condition to run.
"It's still the first year with all these challenges, so in the near future we will concentrate on these two teams."
Newey: A lot of promise in new Honda projects

Aston Martin have scored just seven points this season and are 10th in the Constructors' Championship, although Fernando Alonso says the team were on course for their best race yet on Sunday in Austin, if not for contact with Williams' Alex Albon.
Team principal Adrian Newey says Honda's deficit is "fairly clear" but is encouraged by new developments by the Japanese engine manufacturer.
"Honda - there's a lot of energy and projects on the way now that perhaps are in their early stages of development, but we see a lot of promise from those," he said.

"Too early to comment on exactly where the PU will be at the start of the season and whether then, assuming it's allowed under the PUAC [Power Unit Advisory Committee], there will be further development for what will be race eight at the end of the first period."
Adrian Newey addressed Christian Horner's criticism made in his latest memoirs
Honda's struggles are reminiscent of their turbo-hybrid partnership with McLaren between 2015 and 2017 - a period where they never had a competitive engine.
McLaren and Honda parted ways at the end of 2017, with Honda supplying Toro Rosso, now called Racing Bulls, from 2018 and Red Bull from 2019.
In their first season with Red Bull, Honda scored a podium in the season-opener and Max Verstappen won three races.

Newey said: "At the moment, in all truth, Honda are a little bit behind where Red Bull, as the works team, Red Bull, picked up Honda in 2019. But that obviously was four seasons after they first came back in 2015. So, this is the first year back in.
"They are a great company. I have every confidence that they will accelerate quickly and understand the problems of these particular PU regulations."

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen admits Red Bull was “just a little average” in Austin
detailZh: 维斯塔潘承认红牛在奥斯汀表现“只是平均水平”
维斯塔潘批评了红牛车队的轮胎策略和整体表现
尽管在美式大奖赛中获得第三名，维斯塔潘在赛后表示，车队在轮胎选择、动力单元问题和无线电问题上表现“只是平均水平”。
维斯塔潘在美式大奖赛中获得第三名，落后于基米·安东内利17.5秒，此前他在马来西亚和新加坡的比赛中赢得了前两场比赛。
维斯塔潘将比赛描述为“相当令人沮丧”，并表示米尔顿凯恩斯的赛车队过度依赖了最近周末行之有效的方法。
“事后看来，当然很容易说，但无论什么原因，今天的软胎并没有真正发挥出应有的效果。所以，是的，我想我们使用轮胎的顺序也是错误的。
“此外，我想在某个时刻，使用更硬胎的车手们显然找到了很多抓地力，所以我想我们也没有真正对此做出反应。可能只是过于坚持了我们从上一两场比赛中得出的信念，即软胎是最快的，但显然在这里这并不奏效，”他在赛后新闻发布会上说。
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利将一个令人印象深刻的杆位成绩转化为一场胜利，他在硬胎上采用了一站式策略。红牛和法拉利都选择了两站式策略。
问及为什么与最近几场比赛相比，红牛的速度有所下降，维斯塔潘表示小红牛22在奥斯汀没有明显的优势可以依赖。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、维斯塔潘、红牛车队
“因为我认为我们的赛车平衡得很好。我们既不是高速最快的，也不是低速最快的，我认为也许在这里你需要要么在高速中非常快，要么在低速中是最快的。当你两者都不是时，你只是稍微平庸一点，我认为我们在比赛中就是稍微平庸一点。”
他认为通过不同的策略可以获得第二名，但表示动力单元使得生活更加艰难。
“当然，如果我们选择了不同的轮胎，可能我们能够获得第二名，但事后说这些总是很容易。此外，当你动力单元的稳定性问题太多时，这已经让你损失了自由圈数。所以，你不能做到尽善尽美，或者至少达到最佳状态，这是正常的。我们还有很多事情需要检查和改进。”
他说这场比赛让红牛车队留下了更多需要回答的问题。
“有几个问题需要分析：为什么这些轮胎没有达到我们的预期，或者为什么其他轮胎的表现比预期更好。所以，是的，有一些东西可以从中学习。”"
detailEn: Max Verstappen admits Red Bull was “just a little average” in Austin
Max Verstappen has criticised Red Bull's tyre strategy and overall performance after finishing third at the United States Grand Prix

Despite finishing on the podium, Max Verstappen was disappointed after the United States Grand Prix. Talking after the race, the Dutchman said his Red Bull team was "just a little average" as he faced the wrong tyre choice, power unit problems as well as radio issues.
The Dutchman finished third at the Circuit of the Americas, 17.5 seconds behind Kimi Antonelli, after winning the previous two races in Malaysia and Singapore.
Verstappen described the race as “pretty frustrating” and said the Milton Keynes outfit had relied too heavily on what had worked for it in recent weekends.

“In hindsight, of course, it’s very easy to say, but for whatever reason, the softer compounds today were not really working that well. So, yeah, then also I think the way that we used our tyres in the order was wrong.

"Plus, I think at one point it was quite clear that the people on the harder compounds were finding a lot of grip, so I guess we also didn’t really react to that. Just probably sticking too much to our belief from the last two races, where the softer compounds were the fastest, and clearly here that didn’t work,” he said in the post-race press conference.
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli converted an impressive pole position into a race win with a one-stop strategy on a hard tyre. Red Bull and Ferrari had both chosen the two-stop.
Asked why Red Bull’s pace had dropped off compared to recent races, Verstappen said the RB22 had no standout strength to lean on in Austin.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

“Because I think we are balanced as a car. We are not the fastest in high speed, we’re not the fastest in low speed, and I think maybe here you either need to be very fast in high speed or you need to be the quickest in low speed. When you’re none of it, you’re just a little bit average, and I think we were just a little bit average in the race.”
He believed second place was possible with a different strategy, but said the power unit had made life harder.

“Of course, if we chose different tyres, probably we could have maybe been second, but that’s always easy to say afterwards. Plus, when you have too many issues with the consistency of your power unit, then that already costs you free lap time. So it’s normal that you can’t execute everything to the limit or at least be at your best. There are still a lot of things that we need to look at and do better.”
He said the race had left Red Bull with more questions to answer.
“That’s a few things to analyse: why these tyres didn’t work as we expected, or why the other tyres performed better than expected. So, yeah, something to learn from.”

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff reveals how Williams' surprise victory helped him secure Mercedes role
items.summaryEn: Toto Wolff has revealed that Pastor Maldonado's surprise 2012 Spanish Grand Prix victory for Williams led to a conversation with Mercedes executives that helped him secure his role at Mercedes.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫揭示了威廉姆斯那场意外胜利如何帮助他获得梅赛德斯职位
托托·沃尔夫透露，帕斯托尔·马尔多纳多2012年西班牙大奖赛的意外胜利，如何促成了一场与梅赛德斯高层的对话，这场对话颇具揭示性
梅赛德斯负责人托托·沃尔夫透露，他曾对帕斯托尔·马尔多纳多的一句调侃帮助他获得了在车队的位置；这位奥地利商人还将梅赛德斯明星车手与当时的威廉姆斯车手作了比较。
2012年，沃尔夫是威廉姆斯的股东和高管，当时马尔多纳多在西班牙大奖赛上意外夺冠。那时，梅赛德斯自2010年以厂队身份回归以来只赢过一场，即该赛季早些时候尼科·罗斯伯格在中国站的胜利。
沃尔夫在Stripe联合创始人约翰·科利森主持的Cheeky Pint播客中表示，随威廉姆斯车队夺冠后，他接到了梅赛德斯母公司的电话。
“其中一位董事会成员找到我，邀请我去斯图加特，他说：‘你的私人小车队怎么能赢下一场比赛，而我们梅赛德斯却做不到比这更好？’”沃尔夫说。
在获准查看车队的数据后，沃尔夫问董事会对其F1项目的期望是什么。答案是世界冠军，这位奥地利人告诉他们，他们的雄心与车队的支出并不匹配。
“我说：‘好吧，那我们当中有一个是错的，因为我用的是同样的预算，而我想的是进入前六名。’他们说：‘不，预算不一样。你看，我们多花了1亿。’
“我说，‘是啊，你们在迈克尔·舒马赫和尼科·罗斯伯格身上花了那1亿，我这儿有个来自委内瑞拉的付费车手，’顺便说一句，他赢了那场比赛，就是帕斯托。‘这就是主要区别。’他们完全不喜欢那种局面。我说，‘我只是个传话的，我要回威廉姆斯了。’”
马尔多纳多从委内瑞拉为威廉姆斯带来了大量赞助，他在巴塞罗那从杆位发车击败费尔南多·阿隆索夺冠。这仍然是他F1生涯唯一一场大奖赛胜利。
梅赛德斯后来带着一份邀约回来了。
“最终，他们回来说，‘我们认为我们的模式，即由一家企业运营F1车队，行不通，因为它需要更多由企业家主导，你需要被授权当场做决定，我们想让你来运营这个。’”
沃尔夫表示，他最初拒绝了这一职位，因为他是威廉姆斯的股东，但梅赛德斯提出帮助他转而入股该车队。
他于2013年初加入梅赛德斯，随后该车队从2014年到2021年连续八次赢得车队总冠军。
detailEn: Toto Wolff reveals how Williams' surprise victory helped him secure Mercedes role
Toto Wolff has revealed how Pastor Maldonado's surprise 2012 Spanish Grand Prix victory led to a revealing conversation with Mercedes executives

Mercedes chief Toto Wolff revealed a jibe at Pastor Maldonado that helped him get his place on the team, as the Austrian businessman gave a comparison between the star Mercedes drivers and the then-Williams driver.

Wolff was a shareholder and executive at Williams in 2012, when Maldonado took a surprising victory in the Spanish Grand Prix. At the time, Mercedes had won just once since returning as a works team in 2010, with Nico Rosberg’s victory in China earlier that season.
Speaking on the Cheeky Pint podcast with Stripe co-founder John Collison, Wolff said that the win with Williams was followed by a call from the Mercedes parent company.

“One of the board members approached me and invited me to Stuttgart, and he said, ‘How can it be that your private little team can win a race, and we, Mercedes, we can’t do any better than that?’” Wolff said.

After being given access to the team’s figures, Wolff asked the board what it expected from its F1 programme. The answer was world championships, and the Austrian told them their ambitions did not match the team’s spending.

“I said, ‘OK, then one of us is wrong because I’m working on the same budgets, and I’m thinking about finishing in the top six.’ They said, ‘No, it’s not the same budget. Look, we spend 100 million more.’

“I said, ‘Yeah, those 100 millions you spend on Michael Schumacher and Nico Rosberg, I have a pay driver from Venezuela,’ who won the race, by the way, Pastor. ‘That’s the main difference.’ They didn’t like that situation at all. I said, ‘I’m just a messenger, and I’m going to go back to Williams.’”
Maldonado, who brought substantial backing from Venezuela to Williams, beat Fernando Alonso to win in Barcelona from pole. It remained the only grand prix victory of his F1 career.
Mercedes later returned with an offer.

“Eventually, they came back and said, ‘We think our model, a corporate running a Formula 1 team, doesn’t function, because it needs to be much more entrepreneurially led, you need to be empowered to make decisions on the spot, and we want you to run this.’”
Wolff said he initially turned the role down because he was a shareholder in Williams, but Mercedes offered to help him buy into the team instead.
He joined Mercedes at the start of 2013, and the team went on to win eight consecutive constructors’ championships from 2014 to 2021.

梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫为乔治·拉塞尔的F1冠军前景进行了辩护
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯F1车队负责人托托·沃尔夫驳回了前红牛赛车运动顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥的声称，乔治·拉塞尔永远不会再次获得F1冠军的机会
拉塞尔目前在车手积分榜上落后队友、当前车手冠军领跑者安东内利123分。
在美国赛车场举行的美国大奖赛前夕，马克在接受天空体育德国采访时表示，安东内利已经取代了Brackley车队的主车手位置。
“拉塞尔不再是一号车手。安东内利很显然已经取代了他的位置。但拉塞尔是顶级车手之一，”马克说。 “我怀疑他是否还有机会再次获得世界冠军或者在任何地方获得一号车手的位置。”
在奥斯汀的比赛后，沃尔夫表示马克的观点是错误的。
“我从赫尔穆特开始，我的意思是，他是我的奥地利人，不是那么亲密的朋友，但我尊重他的意见。但我认为他在乔治的问题上是错的。乔治拥有所有的能力。我认为这辆车不适合他。”
“他还补充说：'我认为在赛季初期，面对这种情况可能很困难，那就是我觉得这是我的年份，然后我们这边有一个天才少年开始真正地削弱我们的优势。我相信，乔治，如果我们给他一辆快速的车，新赛季是完全可能的。”
“他拥有赢得冠军的一切所需。所以我认为说让我们忘记他在F2和F3中赢得的所有这些年份，他的新秀赛季，还有他在卡丁车中的连续欧洲锦标赛，这些都还在那里，是有点太容易了。”
“2026赛季第19轮，墨西哥大奖赛，定于10月30日至11月1日举行。”
detailEn: George Russell F1 title chances defended by Toto Wolff after Helmut Marko comments
Mercedes team chief Toto Wolff has defended George Russell's Formula 1 title prospects
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes Formula 1 team chief Toto Wolff has rejected former Red Bull motorsport adviser Helmut Marko's claim that George Russell will never get another shot at the F1 title.
Russell currently sits 123 points behind his team-mate and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the drivers' standings.
While speaking to Sky Sports Deutschland ahead of the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas, Marko said Antonelli had taken over as the Brackley outfit's lead driver.

"Russell is no longer the number one driver. Antonelli has quite clearly taken that spot from him. But Russell is one of the top drivers," Marko said. "I doubt whether he’ll ever have another chance at the world title or be given number one status anywhere."
Asked about the comments after the race in Austin, Wolff said Marko had got it wrong.
"I start with Helmut, I mean, he’s my Austrian, not-so-buddy, but I respect his opinion. But I think he’s wrong on George. George has all the ability. I think the car doesn’t suit him."

He added: "I think that at the beginning of the season, it is maybe difficult to cope with the situation where you’re feeling that this is my year to come, and then we have this wonderkid on the other side that starts to really chip away. And I believe that a new season, George, if we provide him with a quick car, is absolutely possible.

"He has absolutely what it needs to win a championship. So I think it's a bit too easy to say, let's forget about all these years where he won in F2 and F3, his rookie years and the European championships back-to-back in karting, that's still all there."
The 19th round of the 2026 season, the Mexican Grand Prix, is scheduled for 30 October to 1 November.

items.originalTitle: Helmut Marko invests in AI start-up after Red Bull F1 exit
detailZh: 赫尔穆特·马尔科在红牛F1退出后投资了人工智能初创公司
前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马尔科投资了一家奥地利人工智能初创公司
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、赫尔穆特·马尔科、红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前红牛赛车运动顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥成为了一家奥地利人工智能初创公司的投资者，该公司允许人们留下个人信息，在亲人去世后传达给他们。
这位83岁的老人在去年赛季结束后，结束了他在米尔顿凯恩斯车队超过二十年的职业生涯，于10月20日在维也纳曼德勒东方酒店举办的启动仪式上被公布为Lebensstimmen GmbH的支持者。
这家总部位于格拉茨的公司将在国际上以Words That Remain的名义运营，其平台被描述为一种数字化的临终规划。用户在生前录制或写下信息，然后在去世后传递给指定的接收者。
该公司还提供了一种工具，帮助悲伤的家庭整理自己的话语，并推出了一款名为“Fabertar”的人工智能悼词撰写者，该软件与维也纳圣斯蒂芬大教堂的牧师托尼·法贝尔共同开发。Lebensstimmen表示，“Fabertar”明确标明为AI，并不旨在取代神父或演讲者，而是帮助那些无人可用的情况。
马克奥，他建立了红牛的青训项目，并帮助四位冠军车手塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘成长，将这次投资与他自己在赛车界的职业生涯联系起来。
"赛车运动从未留给运气；它通过不断使用新技术来造福人们的勇气而得到改进。这正是我在Lebensstimmen中认识到的态度，马克奥在新闻稿中说。
这家公司由Philipp Berkessy、Markus Pinter和Lukas Stern创立，并计划在2027年第一季度在奥地利和国际上全面推出其平台。
"每个人都有应该保留的话语。通过Lebensstimmen，我们首次使临终规划变得个性化、数字化和合法化。今天，一种新的告别文化开始了，它始于奥地利，"Berkessy说。
detailEn: Helmut Marko invests in AI start-up after Red Bull F1 exit
Former Red Bull adviser Helmut Marko has invested in an Austrian AI start-up
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Helmut Marko, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Red Bull motorsport adviser Helmut Marko has become an investor in an Austrian artificial intelligence start-up that lets people leave personal messages to be delivered to loved ones after they die.

The 83-year-old, who stepped down from his role at the Milton Keynes outfit at the end of last season after more than two decades with the company, was unveiled as a backer of Lebensstimmen GmbH at a launch event at the Mandarin Oriental hotel in Vienna on 20 October.

The Graz-based company, which will operate internationally under the name Words That Remain, describes its platform as a form of digital end-of-life planning. Users record or write messages during their lifetime, which are then passed on to chosen recipients after their death.

The company also offers a tool to help grieving families put their own words together and has launched an AI eulogist called the "Fabertar", developed with Toni Faber, the cathedral pastor of St Stephen's in Vienna. Lebensstimmen says the "Fabertar" is clearly labelled as AI and is not designed to replace priests or speakers, but to help where none are available.
Marko, who built Red Bull's junior programme and helped bring through four-time champions Sebastian Vettel and Max Verstappen, linked the investment to his career in racing.

"Motorsport was never left to chance; it was improved through the courage to consistently use new technologies for the benefit of people. That is exactly the attitude I recognise in Lebensstimmen," Marko said in the press release.
The business was founded by Philipp Berkessy, Markus Pinter and Lukas Stern, and plans to launch its platform fully in Austria and internationally in the first quarter of 2027.

"Every person has words that should remain. With Lebensstimmen, we are making end-of-life planning personal, digital and legally secure for the first time. Today, a new culture of farewell begins, and it begins in Austria," Berkessy said.

items.originalTitle: Red Bull responds to Aston Martin F1 power unit rumours
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that the team is not in "serious conversations" about supplying power units to another Formula 1 team, including Aston Martin.
detailZh: 红牛回应向阿斯顿·马丁供应F1动力单元的传闻
红牛车队领队梅基斯确认，车队并未就向阿斯顿·马丁或任何其他F1竞争对手供应动力单元进行认真讨论
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
红牛车队领队梅基斯确认，车队并未就向另一支F1车队供应动力单元进行“认真谈判”。这其中包括阿斯顿·马丁。
这支总部位于银石的车队整个赛季都在动力单元性能上苦苦挣扎，其与本田的厂商合作关系也一直紧张。如今有报道称，阿斯顿·马丁可能在另寻他处，包括红牛和福特。
红牛本赛季的动力总成令人大感意外，其内燃机被国际汽联定义为标杆，并且已在马克斯·维斯塔潘手中拿下两场胜利。听到围场中的客户车队会对这样的动力单元感兴趣，并不会让人感到意外。在美国大奖赛期间，梅基斯承认确实存在兴趣，但这款动力单元是非卖品。
“你看，我们的引擎性能引来了大量我们不想要的正面关注，这自然也引起了众多车队的注意，”他说。
“我们有没有和任何人认真谈过为另一支车队供应动力单元？没有。我们觉得自己还没准备好。未来五年这是板上钉钉的吗？不是。因为我不知道未来五年会发生什么，但可以肯定的是，对我们来说，我们自己这边有足够的工作要做，去改进动力单元，改进它在赛车中的整合。”
梅基斯坚称，红牛动力总成内部没有人认为这台引擎已经完成。
“我之所以微笑，是因为你在红牛动力总成里很难找到一个人认为这台引擎已经搞定，”他说，“有上千项可驾驶性方面的考量，我们知道可以做得更好，也相信我们会做得更好。”
他补充说，充分发挥引擎与底盘之间协同效应的潜力，是红牛决定自研动力单元的主要原因。
“使用自家动力单元的主要原因之一，就是试图从整合中获取竞争优势，这正是我们所有人努力的方向。”
阿斯顿·马丁的迈克·克拉克也试图淡化这一想法，并确认了车队对这家日本制造商的承诺。
“我只能说我们有一个合作伙伴，一个长期合作伙伴，那就是本田，顺便说一句，本周末它已经完成了第500场比赛，而且我认为当我们一起赢得第一场比赛时，我们也会在一起，”他说。
detailEn: Red Bull responds to Aston Martin F1 power unit rumours
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed the team is not in serious discussions to supply Aston Martin or any other Formula 1 rival with power units
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that the team is not in "serious conversations" when it comes to supplying another Formula 1 team with power units. This includes Aston Martin.

The Silverstone-based team has struggled with its power unit performance all season as its works partnership with Honda has been strained. Now, there are reports of Aston Martin potentially looking elsewhere, including Red Bull and Ford.

Red Bull's powertrain this season has been a huge surprise, with the internal combustion engine being defined as the benchmark by the FIA, and it already securing two victories in the hands of Max Verstappen. It wouldn't come as a surprise to hear that customer teams across the grid would be interested in such a thing. Talking at the United States Grand Prix, Mekies admitted that there certainly is interest, but the power unit isn't for sale.
“Look, we got a lot of unwanted positive publicity about the performance of our engine and that came with certainly attention from a lot of teams,” he said.

“Are we having any serious conversations with anyone to supply another team? No. We don’t feel we are ready for that. Is it set in stone for the next five years? No. Because I don’t know what’s going to happen in the next five years, but for sure, for us there is enough work on our side to improve the power unit, to improve its integration in the car.”
Mekies insisted nobody at Red Bull Powertrains believes the engine is finished.

“I’m smiling because you will struggle to find one person in RBPT that thinks that the engine is sorted,” he said. “There are a thousand driveability considerations that we know we can do better, and we know we will do better.”
He added that getting the most out of the link between engine and chassis was the main reason for Red Bull building its own unit.
“One of the main reasons you use your own power unit is to try to extract a competitive advantage from its integration, and that’s what we are all working towards.”
Aston Martin’s Mike Krack also tried to calm the idea, confirming the team's commitment to the Japanese manufacturer.

“I can only say we have a partner, a long-term partner, which is Honda, that, by the way, has done its 500th race this weekend, and I think we will be together also when we win our first race together,” he said.
keyPointsZh: 梅基斯表示，红牛没有就向阿斯顿·马丁或任何其他F1竞争对手供应动力单元进行认真讨论。
keyPointsEn: Mekies said Red Bull is not in serious discussions about supplying power units to Aston Martin or any other Formula 1 rival.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli extends F1 title lead with US GP win Mercedes didn’t expect
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中赢得F1冠军，梅赛德斯车队并未预料到这一点
安德鲁·肖夫林承认梅赛德斯车队的设置窗口非常狭窄，赞扬基米·安东内利在奥斯汀的神奇胜利
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里有最新的银箭动态，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
在美洲赛车场的周五练习后，梅赛德斯车队的维修区内的数据表明，布拉克利车队正准备收拾行囊，迎接一个糟糕的、毫无积分的周末。赛车落后于节奏，车手们抱怨平衡问题，最近的风力升级看起来是一个巨大的错误。
快进到周日下午，19岁的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利站在领奖台上最高的一步，喷洒着香槟，随意地扩大着他的世界冠军领先优势。
根据梅赛德斯赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林的说法，从周五有些像拖拉机一样的速度到周日的统治性胜利，这种巨大的转变简直是一场奇迹。
在赛后简报中，肖夫林对工程部门在周末的迷茫直言不讳。
“恭喜基米和布拉克利以及布里克斯沃斯的所有人赢得了胜利。在周五之后，鉴于我们的单圈和长距离速度，一场胜利看起来根本无法实现，所以这是一个惊人的转变，一个非常令人满意的结果，”肖夫林承认。
那周五事故的部分原因直接关联到乔治·拉塞尔的赛后评论。拉塞尔在完成比赛并排在较后位置后称赛车为“垃圾”，而肖夫林基本上确认了他们在马来西亚带回的备受期待的提升套件将W17变成了一个具有挑战性的机器。
虽然赛车速度有令人鼓舞的迹象，但自从更新以来，感觉调整窗口变得更加难以把握，”肖夫林承认。
微薄的调整窗口导致了梅赛德斯车手们截然不同的两场比赛。安东内利想出了如何保持车队前部的轮胎状态，而拉塞尔从发车灯亮起的那一刻起就遇到了更多的困难。
“对于乔治来说，那是一个令人沮丧的下午。第一圈偏离赛道所受的处罚没有帮助，尽管他在第二次比赛开始时有一个强劲的起步，但他被皮亚斯特里挡住，找不到突破的方法，”肖夫林指出。
在皮亚斯特里的麦克拉伦车后卡住，实际上让拉塞尔很难从第一圈的赛道限制处罚中恢复过来。
但在安东内利的车库一侧，梅赛德斯维修区在巨大压力下完美执行。当轮胎在崎岖的德克萨斯沥青上磨损加剧时，策略师们并没有恐慌，而是信任他们的数学计算。
“从操作层面来看，车队做得非常好。策略决策并不明显，但我们保持了冷静，做出了正确的决定，坚持一停策略，并且维修区停靠也很稳定，”Shovlin解释道。
最终，Shovlin将所有的赞誉都归功于他的年轻车手，这位车手成功地将一辆不可预测的车拖到了关键的赛季末胜利。
“最关键的是，基米应该对自己的表现感到非常满意。周五的比赛非常艰难，但他今天的排位赛和正赛表现都非常出色。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli extends F1 title lead with US GP win Mercedes didn’t expect
Andrew Shovlin admits Mercedes' setup window is incredibly narrow, praising Kimi Antonelli for a miracle win in Austin
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The telemetry inside the Mercedes garage after Friday practice at the Circuit of the Americas pointed towards the Brackley squad waiting to pack up for a miserable, point-less weekend. The car was off the pace, the drivers were complaining about the balance, and the recent aerodynamic upgrades looked like a massive misstep.
Fast forward to Sunday afternoon, and 19-year-old Andrea Kimi Antonelli is standing on the top step of the podium, spraying champagne and casually extending his world championship lead.
According to Mercedes trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin, the sheer whiplash of going from Friday's somewhat tractor-like pace to Sunday's dominant win was nothing short of a miracle.
During the post-race debrief, Shovlin was incredibly blunt about just how lost the engineering department was heading into the weekend.

"Well done to Kimi and everyone in Brackley and Brixworth on the win. After Friday, a race victory simply didn’t look achievable given our single-lap and long-run pace, so it’s been a remarkable turnaround and a very satisfying result," Shovlin admitted.

Part of the reason for that Friday mishap directly correlates with George Russell's post-race comments. Russell called the car "rubbish" after finishing down the order, and Shovlin essentially confirmed that the highly anticipated upgrade package they brought back in Malaysia has turned the W17 into a challenging machine.
"There were encouraging signs with the car pace, although since the update it does feel like the set-up window has become a little harder to hit," Shovlin confessed.

The razor-thin set-up window resulted in two completely different races for the Mercedes drivers. While Antonelli figured out how to keep the tyres alive at the front of the pack, Russell's afternoon was more difficult from the moment the lights went out.

"For George, it was a frustrating afternoon. The penalty for going off track on the opening lap didn’t help and, despite making a strong start to his second stint, he got stuck behind Piastri and couldn’t find a way through," Shovlin noted.
Getting stuck behind Oscar Piastri's McLaren effectively made it difficult for Russell to recover from his Lap 1 track limits penalty.

But on Antonelli's side of the garage, the Mercedes pitwall executed flawlessly under massive pressure. Instead of panicking when tyre degradation spiked on the brutally bumpy Texas asphalt, the strategists trusted their maths.

"Operationally, though, the team did a very good job. The strategy decisions weren’t clear-cut, but we held our nerve, made the right call to stick with the one-stop, and the pitstops were solid," Shovlin explained.
Ultimately, Shovlin threw all the credit to his teenage driver, who managed to drag an unpredictable car to a crucial late-season victory.
"Most of all, Kimi should be incredibly pleased with his performances. It was a difficult Friday, but what he produced in qualifying and the race today was exceptional."

这是梅赛德斯车队未曾预料到的结果
keyPointsEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the race on Sunday
